introHtml: Koi badge reels combine durable construction with a smooth retraction mechanism, making them a reliable choice for daily ID badge use. The Koi brand is known for vibrant color options that hold up well under repeated stretching, so your logo stays visible. For HR directors and safety managers ordering for large teams, these reels offer consistent performance and a professional look that complements any uniform or lanyard.
